description:
Nimbus Equipments — AMC Plans
---

**AMC-01 — Half-Yearly AMC**
A 6-month preventive maintenance contract designed for compressors under moderate-to-high running hours. Includes two scheduled service visits, filter and lubricant checks, valve and belt inspection, and priority breakdown response. Ideal for units running multiple shifts or in dust/heat-intensive environments where wear accelerates.
**Coverage period:** 6 months
**Scheduled visits:** 2 (once every 3 months)
**Best suited for:** Multi-shift operations, high-load reciprocating and screw compressors, dusty/high-temperature plant environments.

**AMC-02 — Annual AMC**
A comprehensive 12-month maintenance contract covering routine servicing, consumable checks (filters, oil, belts), valve and separator inspection, and performance monitoring across the year. Includes a defined number of scheduled visits plus breakdown support, helping reduce unplanned downtime and extend compressor life.
**Coverage period:** 12 months
**Scheduled visits:** 3–4 (quarterly)
